notes: Summary: POC ran Sep-Nov 2025. Strong perf on isolated chat flows, KV cache helped latency. Finance + Procurement ultimately negotiated enterprise deal with AWS for managed endpoints.
Key quote from CTO (2026-02-03): 'We need one vendor for cloud managed infra — consolidating on AWS simplifies compliance and cost.'

Security: completed initial security review with our answers to SOC2 and KMS integration. Security wanted explicit HSM/KMS workflow and long-term residency guarantees — AWS offered packaged terms via existing enterprise contract.

POC results: latency targets met (95th %ile < 250ms for chat), token costs above their internal target when using dedicated GPUs; Optimize suggestions cut cost ~18% but not enough vs AWS prepaid pricing.
Sales touches: multiple exec sponsor meetings early Q4 2025. Sponsor left org (2026-01) — lost internal champion momentum.

Commercial ask: customer requested model-routing/fallback SLA and a dedicated uplift on price for 3-year commit. Redwood offered dedicated capacity + canary rollouts; AWS countered with existing discounting and managed patching commitments.
POC artifacts: Fireflies call (ff_2026-01-15_3921), pricing deck shared (/drive/Argosy_Redwood_Pricing_Comparison_v1.pdf), security responses (/drive/Argosy_Security_FAQ_Redwood_Response.docx).
Comp notes: Competitor win = AWS SageMaker endpoints + AWS PrivateLink for VPC access. Customer cited "single-vendor bill + internal AWS discounts" as decisive.
Internal: flagged as closed-lost 2026-02-12. CRO notified. Action: mark for nurture sequence and partner enablement (ask AWS partner team for joint outreach).
